display_name: OWASP ASVS validation universe and validator budget (ADR-0034)
validation_rules: exactly one target per ASVS chapter with decision participating, not_applicable or gap and its reason
not_applicable only for zero candidates under complete coverage or all candidates not_participating with resolved citations
participant excerpts are hash-bound to the source snapshot (owasp-participants-bundle.schema.json)
planned validator calls = sum(ceil(l1_l2_control_rows / max_control_target_rows)) over participating chapters; over max_validator_calls is BLOCKED and never accepted
MASVS for a target without a mobile platform is a not_applicable family with its reason
